# Design Innovation and Management MA/MSc

Define your role within contemporary design practice. Whether shaping innovative solutions to complex real-world challenges or leading strategic design processes, this postgraduate programme supports your professional and personal development, preparing you to become a confident, future-focused design innovator and manager.

[Keep reading](https://www.dmu.ac.uk/study/courses/postgraduate-courses/design-innovation-and-management-degree/design-innovation-and-management-degree.aspx#overview)

## Block teaching designed around you

You deserve a positive teaching and learning experience, where you feel part of a supportive community. That’s why most of our postgraduate taught students will enjoy an innovative approach to learning using block teaching, where you will study one module at a time. You will benefit from more regular assessments and feedback, a better study-life balance, and a simplified timetable that provides more time for work, professional development, caring responsibilities, and everything else that's important to you. Our block-taught courses are informed by industry practice, often accredited by professional bodies, and are delivered by passionate and talented academics, wh

y the Design Council’s Skills for Planet initiative, the programme embeds sustainability and regenerative practice throughout its teaching and learning. You will explore how design can create positive change by considering environmental impact, social responsibility and ethical decision-making. Through projects focused on materials, systems and future challenges, you will develop the skills to create meaningful and responsible design solutions.
